reader.requirement: At --std 85 an FD with the EXTERNAL clause must denote the one external file connector of the run unit, shared by every program that describes the file EXTERNAL, for sequential, relative and indexed organizations, unaffected by CALL, exit and CANCEL of a describing program, while a non-EXTERNAL file of the same assignment stays a separate internal connector.

edition-consulted.switches: is2023 (FILE STATUS and LINAGE items must be external, 2023 only); DialectLevel < 2002 runs CheckFileDescriptions, otherwise CheckFormat; cited clause chosen per edition
the connector records the edition (for status-code rules); the ::EXT:: sharing branch does not consult it

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the compile-time agreement checks differ (2023 also requires an external FILE STATUS item); the single shared connector is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf24_05 covers a sequential file between a program and its contained program; not exercised there: separately compiled describers, relative and indexed files, a CANCEL of a describer, a failed OPEN seen from another describer, an internal file of the same assignment

refuter.evidence: Aimed at an external FD described in a program contained in an INITIAL program, which the INITIAL call resets each time (X.2.4.2 GR4) while the external connector must stay open (X.2.4.1 (2) covers only internal connectors; X.5.2.4 GR8). r3_extfileinit.cob at --std 85: 'IN OPEN 00 / IN WRITE 00 CNT=1' x3 (only the first call opens; the internal state is initial each time; WRITE succeeds on the still-open external connector), 'MAIN CLOSE 00' in the separately compiled describer, then 'MAIN READ 00 WRT-01' x3 and 'EOF ... 10'. r12_ext_later.cob: FD EXTERNAL AS refused at 85 (COBOL0900). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.4.5.4 GR4 ... the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.2.4 GR8 ... the text is in GR8'.
